solution: The address bus specifies the required memory location. The control bus carries the read command and relevant timing/control signals. The data bus carries the requested word back to the CPU. Together these coordinate transfer between memory and CPU registers.

marking_points.criterion: Explains coordinated transfer between CPU/registers and memory.
